 Search The Site Mays Landing Woman Killed in Route 40 Crash in Hamilton Township Mays Landing Woman Killed in Route 40 Crash in Hamilton Township
 Chris Coleman Chris Coleman Published: November 9, 2026 Hamilton Township Police Department - Photo: Chris Coleman Share on Facebook 
 Share on Twitter 
 Giana Fortson of Mays Landing died in Sunday's crash 
 Crash happened around 6:18 AM near Route 40 and Strand Avenue 
 Police say Fortson's vehicle struck a Nissan before leaving the roadway 
 Hamilton Township, N.J. — A 23-year-old Mays Landing woman is dead after a crash involving two vehicles on Route 40 Sunday morning.
 Giana Fortson was pronounced dead at the scene. She was the only person in her vehicle and was not wearing a seat belt, according to Hamilton Township Police.
 What Happened
 Officers responded to the area of Route 40 and Strand Avenue around 6:18 AM.
 Route 40 and Strand Avenue in Hamilton Township, NJ - Photo: Google Maps Route 40 and Strand Avenue in Hamilton Township, NJ - Photo: Google Maps MORE NEWS: Cape May County Lowering Speed Limit on Busy Road in Middle Township 
 Investigators with the Hamilton Township Police Department said they determined that Fortson was driving a 2008 Toyota Scion westbound on Route 40 when she lost control and rear-ended a 2025 Nissan Versa driven by 20-year-old Ashlie Guevara Angel of Pleasantville.
 After the impact, Fortson's car left the roadway and hit a tree. The Nissan also left the roadway and came to a stop in a residential yard on the eastbound side of the road.
 No other injuries were reported.
 Route 40 was closed for about four hours during the investigation.
 Investigation Continues
 Anyone who witnessed the crash is asked to contact Sgt. Jacobi at (609) 625-2700.
 The Hamilton Township Rescue Squad, AtlantiCare Paramedics, the Atlantic County Prosecutor's Office, and the New Jersey Department of Transportation assisted at the scene.
